hardware_target: AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX (gfx1100, 24GB GDDR6, 800 GB/s sustained)

inventions.name: Speculative Tree Decoding (Tree-MTP / Branching Candidate Tree)
inventions.implementation_complexity: MEDIUM (Custom Tree Attention Mask in GGML/HIP)
inventions.key_advantage: Eliminates single-line MTP rejections by branching top-3 candidates into 16-node candidate tree in 1 forward pass.

inventions.name: Dynamic Entropy Early-Exit (Adaptive 32/48/64-Layer Depth)
inventions.implementation_complexity: MEDIUM (Requires auxiliary early-exit head at Layer 32)
inventions.key_advantage: Saves 37.5% GDDR6 memory bandwidth per token by skipping remaining 32 layers for predictable syntax tokens.

inventions.name: Jump-Tokens (Direct AST / Grammar Macro Injection)
inventions.implementation_complexity: MEDIUM (Client/router grammar trigger + batch prefill verification)
inventions.key_advantage: Bypasses sequential token decode for repetitive boilerplate code (40-58% of code files), verifying blocks via 320 tok/s prefill.

inventions.name: Dynamic Subspace Weight Sparsification (35% Block-Sparse GEMV)
inventions.implementation_complexity: HIGH (Requires custom RDNA3 Wave32 block-sparse HIP assembly kernel)
inventions.key_advantage: Skips inactive 32-column weight tiles on RDNA3 LDS based on activation channel norms, cutting VRAM read by 5.3 GB.

hybrid_stack_projection.name: Unified Next-Gen Hybrid Architecture (Tree-MTP + Jump-Tokens + Early-Exit)
hybrid_stack_projection.feasibility_assessment: Combining Tree-MTP (Invention 1) with Jump-Tokens (Invention 3) provides the highest chance of immediate success with lowest kernel risk.
